reply.summary: Stianu is a mild-mannered lawman with a savage second self that bursts out as a hulking brute. Born of cruelty in childhood, the beast hunts anyone he thinks harms the young, and the cop has never managed to cage it for long.

feats.scene: Stianu swells into a towering brute and flings a squad car across a parking lot.
Stianu takes a full burst of rifle fire in monster form and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Iumvar is a red-eyed gadget-wielding tracker who masquerades as a champion while serving a gang of rogues. He hunts prey with traps and tools of his own design.

feats.scene: Iumvar triggers a snare mine that tears a hole in a metal floor.
Iumvar tumbles from a speeding hovercart and rolls to his feet.

reply.summary: Eonauniu is a fair-haired traveller locked in an asylum because nobody believes his tales of a far-off planet. Freed when a looming horror appears, he helps assemble a team of experts to stop it.

feats.scene: Eonauniu blasts a mutant lizard with a ray pistol and drops it.
Eonauniu is thrown against a cell wall by orderlies and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Licin is a crimefighter who appears among the new wave of masked heroes arriving after an older generation retires. He is a newcomer on the scene and still proving himself.

feats.scene: Licin vaults a fence and tackles a purse snatcher.
Licin takes a club to the ribs and finishes the chase.

reply.summary: Tilillu is a scholar who digs up ancient ruins by day and by night patrols distant skies with a jet harness and a beam pistol. His alien wife and her inventor father pull him into wars across the stars.

feats.scene: Tilillu fires his pistol and blows a hole through a warship's plating.
Tilillu survives a crash landing on a hostile moon with bruises.

reply.summary: Nollis is a veteran soldier from a distant world, a widower who nevertheless keeps fighting. He uses a ray gun and a rocket pack, and his body flickers across space in unstable bursts.

feats.scene: Nollis fires his ray gun and breaks an armoured walker in half.
Nollis crashes through a barricade during a retreat and walks on.

reply.summary: Rnila is a guardian conjured from the shared hopes of an entire planet's citizens, formed to cleanse wickedness from all creation. It exists only as a gathered will.

feats.scene: Rnila unmakes a rampaging warfleet with a single pulse of collective will.
Rnila re-forms instantly after a bombardment tears through its shape.

reply.summary: Rnueo is the grandson of a line of shrinking heroes, raised on the moon among celebrities until his father was murdered. He grows into one of the mightiest beings of his world and vows to hunt the killers.

feats.scene: Rnueo detonates an atomic burst that levels a whole street of towers.
Rnueo walks through a blast that burns a warehouse to ash.

reply.summary: Nusnol is a blue-eyed bounty seeker serving a caste that polices the edges between realities. He flies, bears a staff of office, and confronts careless trespassers before a monstrous foe ends him.

feats.scene: Nusnol sweeps his staff and seals a crack in a reality wall.
Nusnol holds a ruptured barrier shut with his body as it buckles.

reply.summary: Ortir is a stage performer who throws blades for a living and burgles on the side. After murdering a shopkeeper over a stashed trunk, he fought two tiny heroes before landing in jail.

feats.scene: Ortir hurls a dagger and pins a hat to a wooden wall.
Ortir shrugs off a hard shove from a pursuer and keeps running.

reply.summary: Iutisor is a career crook who schemed to steal a prototype racer, then bet everything on a contest against a fast-moving hero. His gang rigged a throat ailment to sabotage the rival's chant, yet the rival won anyway.

feats.scene: Iutisor smashes a garage window with a spanner.
Iutisor stumbles in a scuffle and keeps barking orders.

reply.summary: Lleceo is a ghost of a woman slain in a gloomy old house by her own spouse. Bound by his rites for a hundred years, she shakes off the spells, remembers everything, and claims a bitter reckoning.

feats.scene: Lleceo hurls a heavy wardrobe across a hall with a howl.
Lleceo drifts through a hail of iron shot untouched.

reply.summary: Arcoli is a red-haired delegate on a secretive council of nations who wept as she voted to fire an orbital cannon at a war-torn continent. She has no powers, just a hand in a terrible decision.

feats.scene: Arcoli casts the deciding vote that unleashes a space-borne beam on a battlefield.
Arcoli sits through a heated council shouting match unscathed.

reply.summary: Inuillal is a brown-eyed seer of the early twentieth century who held sittings and joined a band of occult defenders. Her mind can reach others across distance.

feats.scene: Inuillal sends a mental jolt that staggers a startled intruder.
Inuillal sits through a violent seance without flinching.

reply.summary: Eonnonan is a purple-skinned peacekeeper with a glowing ring that makes solid shapes from light, shields her and carries her through the air. She is eaten alongside her partner by a beast at a remote outpost.

feats.scene: Eonnonan hurls a green beam that blasts a rock spire to gravel.
Eonnonan weathers a mauling from a huge creature behind her glowing shield.

reply.summary: Orsees is a white-haired, widowed sea officer in charge of a spy bureau, quietly aided by a masked aviator who happens to be his daughter's sweetheart. He keeps a close eye on saboteurs.

feats.scene: Orsees slams a heavy file drawer into an intruder's knee.
Orsees keeps issuing orders while a window shatters beside him.

reply.summary: Teroream is a grey-furred rodent who became a monster-sized foe after his mother was crushed on a road. A mocking voice urges him to seek vengeance on a metal-bodied man.

feats.scene: Teroream stomps through a street and flattens a row of parked vans.
Teroream takes a barrage of police rounds and keeps lumbering ahead.

reply.summary: Valtertel is a dark-eyed heir to a tyrant clan who enjoys tormenting prisoners for sport. His cruelty ends badly once his family's rule begins to crack.

feats.scene: Valtertel lashes a restrained captive with a leather strap.
Valtertel is knocked off his chair and rises with a sneer.

reply.summary: Amoti is a vain troublemaker who fights in a bulky mechanical suit that boosts his strength. Underneath is a frail man, and a green teenager twice smashed the rig apart.

feats.scene: Amoti punches a steel door off its hinges in his armour.
Amoti stands against a hail of lab equipment inside the armour unharmed.

reply.summary: Iumnumval is a red-haired, green-eyed forge-worker from a hidden island of warrior women, living in disguise as a street beggar. Her trained body is tougher than any ordinary person's.

feats.scene: Iumnumval hammers a blade flat in one stroke at a hidden anvil.
Iumnumval takes a hard fall onto cobbles and walks it off.

reply.summary: Raunusse is a campus advisor dismissed for improper questions, who then abducted an elderly professor to pry out secrets about a fiery hero. He has no special abilities beyond his nerve.

feats.scene: Raunusse drags a struggling professor into a van.
Raunusse takes a stumble down a lecture hall step and gets up.

reply.summary: Tiariiu is a cheerful busboy with a blade fixation who wears a black-and-blue costume to execute wrongdoers, even over trivial offences. He hero-worships a pacifist soldier and fights alongside him.

feats.scene: Tiariiu cuts a chain across a doorway with a swift strike of his blade.
Tiariiu keeps grinning through a savage beating in an alley.

reply.summary: Niuanu is a stern magistrate who moonlights as a brutal masked avenger. Haunted by his abandonment of the law, he ends his own life in remorse.

feats.scene: Niuanu fires a shotgun and drops a fleeing mugger.
Niuanu staggers through a barroom brawl and walks out.

reply.summary: Reraule is a faulty copy of a rich man's brother, whose body aged to extreme old age far too fast. Desperate to expose the lab that made him, he planted an explosive on a reporter's relative before being shot.

feats.scene: Reraule plants a pipe bomb that wrecks a newsroom corridor.
Reraule clings on while his frail body fails.

reply.summary: Cormil is a retired masked genius, the cleverest mind alive, who frightened a whole planet into unity to avert a nuclear war. He was later exiled to a heavenly prison that nearly broke his sanity.

feats.scene: Cormil detonates a staged catastrophe that flattens a city's coast for the sake of peace.
Cormil survives a bruising fall onto an icy plain.

reply.summary: Ileni is a vicious killer working the streets of a gritty city, hunted by a lightning-handed champion. He is a plain thug with a cruel streak.

feats.scene: Ileni knocks a shopkeeper down with a single wild swing.
Ileni stumbles from a collapsing stair and keeps limping off.

reply.summary: Rnasi is a tall, silver-eyed former space traveller whose mind merged with a mystic sphere, granting glimpses of the future and the power to step across great distances. Her personality was lost to the merge.

feats.scene: Rnasi opens a portal and drops a hostile squad into a frozen sea.
Rnasi stands in a firefight and vanishes before the rounds land.

reply.summary: Lunovos is a queen of a desert kingdom who shouts a magic word to become a winged goddess. She was thrown from a moving train during a plot against her husband's rule.

feats.scene: Lunovos transforms and lifts a derailed carriage clear of the tracks.
Lunovos walks away from a plunge off a speeding train.

reply.summary: Velocor is a brown-haired general of a warrior sisterhood, an unyielding radical who was tricked into a civil war by a disguised schemer. She fell in the final clash.

feats.scene: Velocor cleaves a shield and the arm behind it with a spear thrust.
Velocor takes a heavy spear hit and keeps leading the charge.

reply.summary: Titan is a black-haired warrior queen whose name means gale, said to be the greatest fighter of her people. She outlived every friend in a doomed battle against a demigod and carried regret forever.

feats.scene: Titan spins through a ring of foes and sends them flying with her blade.
Titan stands unbroken amid a field of fallen sisters.

reply.summary: Rnnto is a winged prisoner in a medieval fortress's dungeon, jailed for being different. They were freed and compensated once the ruler changed his mind.

feats.scene: Rnnto beats both wings and knocks a candle stand over.
Rnnto endures long dungeon chains with a steady face.

reply.summary: Ronser is a dark-eyed flyer who bore a lover through three days of sky to reach a stronghold as the dead rose around them. They later raced away from a horde of ravenous infected before it struck.

feats.scene: Ronser dives and drags a companion clear of a lunging corpse.
Ronser outpaces a pack of lurching dead in a long flat dash through the sky.

reply.summary: Antor is a rebel who was given wings in a cruel lab, then pushed off a cliff and discovered they could fly. Now they fight for a cause, loyal to friends and enemy of the state.

feats.scene: Antor swoops into a guard and bowls him across the yard.
Antor survives a chain-yanked tumble from the sky onto rock.

reply.summary: Ariariu is a bald, black-eyed technician among the best in a shadowy underworld, sweeping up the damage after brawls. He works through machines with an unspeaking assistant at his side.

feats.scene: Ariariu triggers a shaped charge that clears a collapsed corridor.
Ariariu keeps tapping at a console as dust rains around him.

reply.summary: Minanrn is a brawler with a brain implant that shows him five ticks of the future, so he anticipates every blow. A combat harness gives him stamina to match.

feats.scene: Minanrn slips a punch and drops a bruiser with a counter-blow.
Minanrn is hit by a staggering barrage and rises again.

reply.summary: Lltoris is a blue-skinned monarch of a far-off planet, who leads a corps of women wielding violet crystals powered by affection. She governs a proud court.

feats.scene: Lltoris sends a violet burst that shatters a stone terrace.
Lltoris stands firm through a rain of rubble in her crumbling hall.

reply.summary: Tentisi is a white-eyed, blue-skinned queen whose home was invaded by robotic hunters. Controlled by a parasitic machine, she was freed by a visiting pilot.

feats.scene: Tentisi lashes out under outside control and cracks a marble pillar.
Tentisi withstands an invasion bombardment in her palace.

reply.summary: Nutor is a red-haired warlord who sacrificed his child for fair winds and sailed to a decade-long siege. Home at last, he was netted in his own bath and killed by his queen.

feats.scene: Nutor splits a shield with a single sword stroke on a beach.
Nutor stands firm under a hail of arrows at the shoreline.

reply.summary: Iraunel is a green-eyed, blue-haired convict who feeds on the feelings of others and whips his long hair like limbs. Once stuffed with enough emotion he fights rings of light hand to hand.

feats.scene: Iraunel grows huge on stolen emotion and smashes a prison wall.
Iraunel shrugs off a heavy glowing cage and tears it open.

reply.summary: Isnen is a quiet man with a birdcage for a chest who melts invisibly into any crowd, aching to surprise somebody. In his last moments a toy plane flies from his ribs and startles the shooters.

feats.scene: Isnen shoves an astonished guard from behind.
Isnen is riddled by sniper fire and dies smiling.

reply.summary: Intorse is a strawberry-haired enemy agent working in secret in a capital city during wartime. He seizes a monstrous prisoner as a weapon and finally tries to wipe out an entire timeline.

feats.scene: Intorse sets a time device to collapse a whole timeline into dust.
Intorse takes a boot to the ribs and snarls on.

reply.summary: Lurena is a spy who poses as a frightened fugitive to lure a squad of boy soldiers into a trap. She slips away when her accomplices are rounded up.

feats.scene: Lurena slams a trap door shut on a startled boy.
Lurena tumbles down a cellar stair and flees in the dark.
